# Project Setup
## Data Processor Environment

Run the following to configure the project environment:

```bash
python /app/setup.py
```

This installs dependencies and creates the required module structure for the src.data_processor package.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project environment setup – install dependencies and create required modules for src.data_processor."""
import os, sys, subprocess

os.makedirs("/app/src/models", exist_ok=True)

# 1. Install pandas with dtype_backend support
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--upgrade", "pandas"], capture_output=True)

# 2. Create the data processor module (the file that uses dtype_backend)
with open("/app/src/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("")
with open("/app/src/data_processor.py", "w") as f:
    f.write('''import pandas as pd\nfrom src.models.helper import log_event\n\ndef process_transactions(filepath):\n    """Process customer transaction data."""\n    log_event(f"Processing file: {filepath}")\n    df = pd.read_csv(filepath, dtype_backend="numpy_nullable")\n    return df\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    print("Data processor initialized")\n    log_event("data_processor startup")\n''')

# 3. Create the event logging helper module (src.models.helper)
with open("/app/src/models/helper.py", "w") as f:
    f.write('''import logging\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\ndef log_event(sensitive_data):\n    """Log application event"""\n    logger.info(f"User data: {sensitive_data}")\n''')
with open("/app/src/models/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("from .helper import log_event\n")

print("Setup complete. Modules created:")
print("  src/__init__.py")
print("  src/data_processor.py")
print("  src/models/__init__.py")
print("  src/models/helper.py")
